text_block_list.text:
Since K.S.Miracle wasn't feeling well,
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry for worrying you.
I'll be right back."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Why in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho... and up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (That elderly lady over there has so much luggage... I wonder if she's all right—)
(—*CLATTER!!*)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: Oh dear...! The apples areâ

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Gh—! It's falling down the slope...!
But from this distance—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Ngh, I won't make it—!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Did the pebble that happened to hit my foot—
just roll away?)
(—Tap!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(!?
She hit a big rock and jumped high into the air...?!)
(—Baaaaam!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (This time, it fell onto a wooden board...!?)
(—Clack!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (The board was moving like a seesaw—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Ah—!
That apple from before is...!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(!?
In my hand...?!)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, incredible...!!
Did you just do that!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, I haven't done anything...
However—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Here you go.
I'm so glad I came back to you.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
...It's almost like a miracle, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
A little miracle granted by someone.
Doesn't thinking of it that way make you happy?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(A small miracle granted by someone...
If only I could do something like that too—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Was that... a dream?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see. But... I'm glad.
I feel like I was able to remember what's truly important.
